embedding_description: Ingest knowledge from files or directories into long-term memory. Provide path, optional glob pattern, recursive flag, tags, and memorize option. Returns counts of memories created and files skipped. Works well with markdown sources by default.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Ingestion results with memories_created count and file statistics
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Determine the appropriate next action based on the context and action result.
